I'm sorry — I couldn't make anything yet. Magic Hour turned down the poster request because your account has no credits left, so I couldn't start the video either. Nothing was made and you weren't charged.

Here's what I'll do once you have credits. Your free credits may refill, or you can buy a credit pack in Magic Hour.
- Poster (9:16, 640px, free image model): warm food stalls under string lights, with exactly these words: "Night Market", "Saturday 12 July", "6–10 pm", "Riverside Yard", "Free entry". It costs about 10 credits.
- Video: an 8-second clip with no sound, made from the poster at 480p, with a slow camera push and flickering lights. It costs about 192 credits. One catch: the video model may blur or change the words as it moves. If you'd prefer, I can make the video from the same scene with no text instead.

Let me know when you have credits and which video option you want, and I'll make both.
